exposure: Personal experience of an expanded maternal morbidity composite
outcome: Patient values and perceptions of maternal complications
Themes of patient-perceived adverse maternal events
cohort: Postpartum patients recruited from an urban, academic hospital prior to discharge from their delivery admission.
finding: Adverse maternal outcomes important to patients, particularly severe postpartum depression, do not correlate directly with established severe maternal morbidity (SMM) composites.
mod_finding: The study utilized purposive sampling by mode of delivery and recorded cesarean delivery rates, but no specific findings were reported regarding the mode of birth.
cross-section timing: Immediate postpartum, prior to discharge from delivery admission (survey data collected over 5 months, 6/2022 to 11/2022).
